test_item:
This function shall apply AuthData when it is found in USB storage
(AuthData at the root of the USB external memory is received)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Insert USB drive containing the AuthData package into HU USB port
2. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. <SAM AuthData reception evidence provided by RD (X-g)>
2. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the received AuthData
